name: autocatalog-media
description: Screenshots and GIFs of the example sites for the README and docs, recorded from passing executable stories.

scripts.media: DEMO=1 playwright test --workers=1 && executable-stories gif reports/raw-run.json --output-dir ../../docs/media
scripts.media:one: sh -c 'DEMO=1 playwright test --workers=1 -g "${1:?usage: pnpm media:one \"<scenario title>\"}" && executable-stories gif reports/raw-run.json --output-dir ../../docs/media' --
